new_statements.second_reader_evidence: The report lists no work as silent or not opened (the single listed work was opened). As a substitute spot-check I re-examined the two Haselow papers already in the same folder, which our earlier reading (2026-09-17) marked silent: — 'acent' 5 hits are all 'adyacentes'; tónic/átona/prosod/sílaba/entonaci 0; the only phonetic remark is sec. 7, aquí/allí/ahí merging as [a'si:]; nothing on stress placement. — 'acentuación' appears only in fn. 8 (pp. 69-70), a generic definition of 'complejidad fonológica' listing 'la estructura de la sílaba, la estructura prosódica, acentuación o procesos fonológicos' as criteria in the literature, then defining complexity by articulatory control; no statement…

sources.citation: García Marcos, Alberto. 2013. Adquisición del español como segunda lengua. El caso de la integración lingüística de escolares inmigrantes en Almería. PhD thesis, Universidad de Almería.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Only other linguistic study of immigrant Spanish in Almería surfaced by Dialnet; concerns schoolchildren's L2 Spanish, not the adult pidgin, so unlikely to supersede but might contain pronunciation/prosody remarks on the same population's speech.

sources.citation: Haselow, Alexander. 2009. Características del vocabulario del pidgin español en Almería (Andalucía). Revista Española de Lingüística 39(1): 61-76. DOI 10.31810/rsel.v39i1.54
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress placement. Article is on vocabulary (local deixis, antonym avoidance, multifunctional lexemes). Only prosody mention is footnote 8 (pp. 69-70), a generic definition of 'complejidad fonológica' listing 'la estructura de la sílaba, la estructura prosódica, acentuación' as criteria used in the literature; p. 69 notes a segmental change /abaxo/ > /abako/. Glottolog tags it phonology or text collection, but it contains no phonological description.

sources.citation: Haselow, Alexander. 2004. Analogías, simplificaciones y la búsqueda del mínimo común múltiplo: Notas sobre el español de los inmigrantes de Roquetas de Mar (Almería). Tonos Digital 8 (Universidad de Murcia), unpaginated HTML.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sections: 1 Introducción, 2 El sintagma nominal, 3 El sintagma verbal, 4 La sintaxis, 5 El vocabulario, 6 La lengua de los inmigrantes (pidgin status), 7 Conclusión, 8 Bibliografía. a full-text search for stress/accent acento/acentuación/tónica/sílaba/prosodia/entonación: zero hits. Only phonetic remark (sec. 7): aquí [a'ki:], allí [a'λi:], ahí [a'i:] merge into [a'si:] (transcriptions show final stress, but these are just Spanish source forms; no rule stated).

sources.citation: Dialnet full-text searches ('pidgin Roquetas de Mar'; 'español inmigrantes Roquetas de Mar lingüística'); Crossref query; APiCS contributions list
sources.note: No further description of this pidgin found. Dialnet surfaced only García Marcos, Alberto 2013 (PhD, Universidad de Almería, 'Adquisición del español como segunda lengua. El caso de la integración lingüística de escolares inmigrantes en Almería'), which concerns L2 Spanish of immigrant schoolchildren, not this pidgin. APiCS has no contribution located in Spain.

sources.citation: Haselow, Alexander. Field recordings / underlying study of the Roquetas de Mar immigrant corpus (Universität Potsdam, c. 2003-2004; the 2004 article is based on recorded face-to-face speech, sec. 1 and fn. 2). No thesis record located.
